content: FastAPI BackgroundTasks is same-process, runs after response, NOT for minutes-long external scripts (official docs point to Celery/RQ for heavy work - overkill here). Correct pattern for triggering gogo CLI scripts: async endpoint -> asyncio.create_task(runner) with single-flight asyncio.Lock per operation (409/202 semantics), runner uses asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(sys.executable, script, cwd=scripts/daily) - never blocking subprocess.run in an async def (freezes event loop). Must drain stdout/stderr via proc.communicate() or DEVNULL to avoid ~64KB pipe-buffer deadlock. Keep run registry + last-exit-code in app.state and optionally a JSON run-status file; return 202 Accepted + run id immediately.
